business.description: Shivalik Rasayan Limited is an integrated chemical enterprise spanning agrochemicals and high-value active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The Company has evolved from a legacy producer of technical-grade agrochemicals into a science-led chemical and life sciences manufacturer with a strong presence across the agrochemical and pharmaceutical value chains, underpinned by its DSIR-recognized R&D centre and US FDA-approved facility.

outlook.statement: Strengthening R&D capabilities, expanding CDMO engagements and strengthening presence in regulated markets; focus on converting scientific capabilities into commercial opportunities and building a more resilient and valuable business.
Agrochemical plant at Dahej-III expected to generate approximately Rs. 200 Crores over the next two years.
Advancing API opportunities in Japan and South Korea; two additional API programs with a US-based company focused on NCE-1 and F2F products.
Progressively transforming R&D into a profit-generating business through internal and customer-led projects.
Indian agrochemicals industry expected to witness stable growth of approximately 6-8% in 2026-27, supported by steady domestic demand, improving crop intensity, and expanding distribution reach.
Global API market valued at over USD 159.3 billion in 2026, projected to surge toward USD 228.7 billion by 2033; India API manufacturing growth at center of supply chain shift.
Margin sensitivity persists, necessitating continued focus on product mix optimization and geographic diversification to mitigate concentration risk.
New Agro-Chemical plant at Dahej expected to be fully utilized in next two years.

qualifications_or_emphasis: During the year under review, the Statutory Auditors did not report any matter under Section 143(12) of the Act

During the period under review, as per Regulation 18 (2) (b) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, The quorum for audit committee meeting shall either be two members or one third of the members of the audit committee, whichever is greater, with at least two independent directors.
